user.title: Set up ZHA Debug Capture
user.description: Click Submit to enable ZHA Debug Capture. The integration registers a sidebar panel and a set of services to capture filtered Zigbee traffic for selected ZHA devices, with an in-memory buffer to reduce SD-card wear.

abort.already_configured: ZHA Debug Capture is already set up.

init.title: ZHA Debug Capture options
init.description: Toggle the sidebar entry. Restart Home Assistant (or reload the integration) for the change to take effect.

start.name: Start ZHA capture
start.description: Capture all Zigbee in/out messages of the selected devices. Buffered in RAM, written to disk periodically or on stop.

stop.name: Stop ZHA capture
stop.description: Stop the active capture session, perform a final flush, restore original logger levels.

list_captures.name: List saved captures
list_captures.description: Return the list of saved capture files.
